Data from reliable sources (UN, World Bank, Our World in Data, Gapminder) shows dramatic progress over decades/centuries:

- **Poverty and Hunger**:
  - Extreme poverty (<$2.15/day, 2017 PPP) fell from 42% of global population in 1981 to ~8.5% in 2023 (World Bank).
  - Undernourishment dropped from 23% in 2000 to 9% in 2023 (FAO). Billions lifted out of destitution, largely due to economic growth in Asia (China, India).
